name: grassland_carbon_sampling_design
_README: Template for Part 2, Steps 1 and 2 of the Grassland Carbon Workshop.
Coordinates are longitude, latitude in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Replace every
coordinate below; the ones here are a placeholder square near Regina and
exist only so the file opens and draws in QGIS, ArcGIS, Earth Engine or
Three feature roles, set by the 'role' property:
study_area  exactly one. The outer boundary from Step 1.
exclusion   any number. Wetland, road, outcrop, shelterbelt, dugout.
Subtract these from the study area before recording net area.
stratum     any number. The meaningfully distinct areas from Step 2.
AREA: do not trust an area computed in degrees. Reproject to a metre-based
CRS appropriate to your site before measuring - a UTM zone, or a Statistics
Canada Lambert (EPSG:3347) for prairie-wide work - then record area_m2.
Delete this _README key before loading the file into a tool that validates

properties.inclusion_rule: One sentence: what is in, what is out, and how you told them apart.
properties.boundary_source: property survey / drawn from imagery / existing management unit

properties.exclusion_type: wetland / road / rock outcrop / shelterbelt / dugout / other

properties.stratum_rule: An objective rule, e.g. 'north of the cross-fence, rotationally grazed since 2015'.
